generate_diverse_personas: create diverse persona characteristics using QMC sampling and an LLM along specified diversity axes
generate_persona_memories: generate formative memories and appropriateness rules for a single persona given its characteristics
build_persona_generator: build a two-stage persona generator that creates diverse personas with quantitative trait positions
review_qmc_sampling: review the Quasi-Monte Carlo Sobol point sampling used to distribute persona traits across diversity axes
refactor_backstory_generation: refactor the backstory episode generation to produce appropriateness rules grounded in quantitative trait scores
